This document outlines the testing procedure for 
the gas turbine protection system 250 M.W. at the location new talkha combined 
cycle 750 M.W

The first draft initiated by eng. Wael Ahmed Shoaib, 
revised by eng. Ashraf farid Ali, accepted by eng. Adel Abdelkader Elnagar 
approved by eng. Elsherbiny Ismail I&C maintenance general manager and approved 
by eng. Ibrahim Hassan head sector of new Talkha power station (750 M.W)

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El gilil 
MDEPC quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
eng. Mohamed Nageeb instruiction quality control's head sector

items: Ensure that the gas turbine is out of service, at cold state

Review technical 
 reference materials and manufacture's manual

Review all the wiring for 
 all speed sensors

Measure the voltage of the card for 
 speed sensor (24 VDC)

Measure the gap between each speed 
 sensor and the shaft (1.5mm)

Review the terminals connection for 
 these speed sensors in the junction box

If there is a dust on the any speed 
 sensor, then clean the contact

If there is fault on any speed 
 sensor, then change

Testing the over speed protection 
 circuit and check the setting value of this speed
Check any tools can forget in the cabinet
Close the cabinet of speed card

text:
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure for 
the gas turbine protection system 250 M.W. at the location new talkha combined 
cycle 750 M.W
The first draft initiated by eng. Wael Ahmed Shoaib, 
revised by eng. Ashraf farid Ali, accepted by eng. Adel Abdelkader Elnagar 
approved by eng. Elsherbiny Ismail I&C maintenance general manager and approved 
by eng. Ibrahim Hassan head sector of new Talkha power station (750 M.W)
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El gilil 
MDEPC quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
eng. Mohamed Nageeb instruiction quality control's head sector
Safety 
Precautions
Work 
 order must be issued
Wear 
 safety helmet
Ensure that the gas turbine is out of service, at cold state
Tools and Equipment
Digital Ammeter
Set of key
Contact cleaner
Filer
Lighting lamp
Work to be carried out
Review technical 
 reference materials and manufacture's manual
Review all the wiring for 
 all speed sensors
Testing procedure
Measure the voltage of the card for 
 speed sensor (24 VDC)
Measure the gap between each speed 
 sensor and the shaft (1.5mm)
Review the terminals connection for 
 these speed sensors in the junction box
If there is a dust on the any speed 
 sensor, then clean the contact
If there is fault on any speed 
 sensor, then change
Testing the over speed protection 
 circuit and check the setting value of this speed
Check any tools can forget in the cabinet
Close the cabinet of speed card
